name: dsdv_eng_tap_w

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered inline tap on the irg->ctrl reader link: every output (rqo / rro / pco / fault) is a flop, every input lands in its first flop after <= 3 gates (rqi->rqo, rri->rro 1:1 + demux; rci decode); the die lands every input (G8IQ die.v w_*_lnd) and a flow pin register would add 2 unpriced cycles on every reader request / response of PC 0/1.

fill_reason.pin_bound: TOK-FUNC2-ENG_TAP_W 10-21: drop-in for the G8IQ plan slot etap_00 (216 x 648, plan_routed_g8): W 636 / E 636 / N 311 pins; ~4.4k flops -> low util by construction (slot = pin faces of the reader link).

structural_change: TOK-FUNC2-ENG_TAP_W 10-21: NEW leaf kit for the G8IQ stand-in master dsdv_eng_tap_w (u_etap_00, west end of the Engram request / response chains; dsdv_eng_tap_c WEST=1 of rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/eng/dsdv_eng_rr.sv). Faces from plan_routed_g8 links: reader irg_00 W (rqi / rro), controller ctrl_00 E (rqo / rri), chains etap_01 N (rci / pco). Outline = slot.

job.purpose: TOK-FUNC2 G8IQ stand-in close: Engram west-end tap dsdv_eng_tap_w to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit) -> S81-DIE9 G9 bind.
